lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: Thank you for confirming.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I had no idea such a terrible thing had occurred...

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: Are you sure my mother wasn't among them?
Positive. We just finished identifying all the bodies.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: Very well...
For a while, there is no response.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I assume you reported it?
What do you think? We found over 10 dead civilians up on the surface.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: So you did.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I understand.
If there's anything else on your mind, now's the time to tell me.
Once again, there is no response for a long time.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I didn't intend to string you along,

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: but if I had told you all of the details,

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I would have been putting my mother in danger.
Can you tell me now?

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: Actually,

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: my mother has been obsessed with this

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: pseudo-religious cult calling themselves the Torch of Salvation.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: They're a group who worship Raptures as gods.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: If the government found out my mother was a member,

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: they'd do more than just throw her in prison.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: That's why I couldn't give you the full picture initially.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I'm very sorry.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: And could you tell me...

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: Will the Central Government be launching a formal investigation?
Most likely.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: If my mother is caught,

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: they'll throw the book at her, won't they?
Probably.
I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: I think I'll take it from here.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: Thank you.
Wait.
A while later, my message still shows as being unread.
All I can do now is wait for the results of the government investigation.
